MYCOSOFT  /  ITDX26 PREPARATION
7 SEPTEMBER 2026
Preparation supplement • Targets are not measured results
1
MYCOSOFT / MORGAN / 7 SEPTEMBER 2026
Your brief for the drive
Lead with an inspectable analyst workflow: what changed, what is connected, what options
remain admissible, and where the evidence belongs on a map. Then demonstrate whether combining
algorithms improves the result at an acceptable cost.
I reviewed all 29 supplied files: five Markdown files, fourteen PDFs, seven Word documents, two staged
SQL migrations, and the figure contact sheet. The preparation is extensive. The remaining readiness
question is whether the exact laptop bundle contains the checkpoints, accepted data, executable
harness, and measured reports described by these plans.
A 60–90 second opening
“Mycosoft is developing a grounded analyst workflow from measured signals to evidence-backed
decisions. NLM estimates environmental state and uncertainty. Form Space is our proposed
representation of organized states, their relationships, and possible transitions under explicit constraints.
For ITDX, we connect that representation to four products: pattern analysis, link analysis, courses of
action, and a map product.
“We will identify which components are running in this configuration, compare them with simpler
baselines, and expose the evidence behind the outputs. We will also show what happens when evidence
is missing or contradictory. MYCA proposes options; AVANI checks explicit constraints; the analyst
retains the decision. Our result is the measured quality, limitations, interaction benefit, and runtime of
this particular configuration. Broader Form Space capabilities remain research hypotheses until their
tests support them.”
Task
Question to answer
Product to open
12 / NLM
What changed, and when?
Pattern worksheet with evidence and uncertainty.
13 / FUSARIUM
What is linked, and why?
Typed graph and a traceable evidence path.
8 / MYCA
Which options satisfy the constraints?
Distinct options, critiques, gate results and unknowns.
14 / CREP
Where, when, and with what confidence?
Map with source age, provenance and export.
Keep these five questions in mind: What went in? What algorithm ran? What baseline did it beat or
fail to beat? What changed when another algorithm was added? What did it cost in time and memory?
Source basis: S01, S08–S15, S19–S24. This is a preparation supplement, not an Army-issued agenda or a certification of
runtime readiness.

MYCOSOFT  /  ITDX26 PREPARATION
7 SEPTEMBER 2026
Preparation supplement • Targets are not measured results
2
ITDX26 / PREPARATION & DOCUMENT REVIEW
What ITDX expects—and what is confirmed
The public solicitation summary frames ITDX26 around algorithm effectiveness, limitations, interaction,
and speed/efficiency for the future AI Analyst. It invites participation in one or more of sixteen tasks.
Your supplied selection memo chooses four; it does not establish an obligation to demonstrate all
sixteen. [W1, W2, S15]
Evidence level
What the available record supports
Public program context
Solicitation W91RUSI-FCID260001. The publicly accessible summary describes the four
evaluation questions above. The linked SAM page did not expose the full current
attachments in this review.
Mycosoft event plan
September 8–18, University of Arizona Sierra Vista; unclassified, algorithm-only,
laptop-based. This is repeated in the latest supplied plans. The original government scope
email and final agenda were not supplied.
Selected scope
September memo: Tasks 12, 13 and 8 primary; Task 14 secondary. July plan: 12/13
primary, 8 conditional, 14 stretch. Use the September scope only for components whose
readiness you can substantiate.
Internal performance
targets
90 s / 120 s / 240 s task caps, 420 s integrated cap, 30 s cold start, 5 s map refresh and
300 s reconciliation are planned targets. Do not describe them as confirmed Army
pass/fail thresholds.
Unverified final
instructions
Exact room, reporting time, evaluation slot length, final injects, scoring rubric, data
transfer rules, network arrangements and roster/NDA acceptance.
Arrival items to resolve first
Roster: the latest draft lists Morgan and RJ; an earlier plan says Morgan plus an engineer to be named.
Confirm the actual accepted roster and who operates the terminal. Paperwork: the draft cites a
separate NDA plus Exhibit A for each participant, due September 3 COB. Its “sent separately” wording is
not a receipt; verify the acceptance record. [S19, S27]
Calendar: September 8–18 spans nine weekdays, not eight. The packet’s “8-day event” language
therefore needs the final agenda before assigning day numbers. Initial public notices and the later
internal venue/date account differ; use the government’s latest direct message to resolve them.
Useful opening question for the evaluators: “Which scenario, output format and scoring criterion
would you like us to prioritize in this slot, and which faults do you want injected?” Bring the prepared
matrix; record any changes before running.
Source basis: S01, S08, S15, S16, S19, S27; W1–W2. No external messages were sent during this review.

MYCOSOFT  /  ITDX26 PREPARATION
7 SEPTEMBER 2026
Preparation supplement • Targets are not measured results
3
ITDX26 / PREPARATION & DOCUMENT REVIEW
A shorter spoken Form Space narrative
Suggested approximately four-minute version. Rehearse it once with a timer; spoken pace varies. The supplied five-minute
narrative has 1,313 words, about nine to ten minutes at 130–150 words per minute. Preserve its philosophical material for a
longer research discussion. [S26]
“The problem we are addressing is that an analyst receives many observations, but observations are not
yet a trustworthy picture of what is happening. Sensors can disagree, reports can repeat one another,
and a confident-looking answer can hide missing evidence.
“The Nature Learning Model is our approach to estimating state from grounded measurements. The
architecture brings together calibrated signal channels, temporal memory, and relationships between
observations. Every useful estimate should carry its time, source, model version, uncertainty, and
supporting evidence.
“Form Space changes what we want that estimate to represent. An embedding tells us where an
observation sits in a learned representation. A Form State is intended to say more: what organized state
the system appears to occupy, which local model applies, what target or stable region is relevant, and
what transitions are supported by evidence. It also records boundaries, missing information, and
whether a proposed transition is admissible.
“That is a research program with testable parts. If we claim that two states are equivalent for a task, we
must define the rule and show that the grouping remains useful on held-out observations. If we claim
recovery toward a target, we need a controlled comparison against passive dynamics, repeated
observations, and a stopping test. A signal anomaly alone does not establish a goal or prove a universal
theory of form.
“For ITDX, we make the idea concrete through four analyst products. Task 12 identifies a change or
recurring pattern. Task 13 tests and explains relationships, keeping observed connections separate from
inferred ones. Task 8 uses the resulting evidence to compare distinct options under explicit constraints.
Task 14 renders the state and evidence on a map that an analyst can inspect and export.
“MYCA coordinates the proposal and critique process. AVANI evaluates the declared constraints outside
the learned model. A passing gate means an option satisfied those checks; it does not grant command
authority. MINDEX preserves the versions and evidence lineage so an evaluator can inspect what
produced an answer.
“Our field architecture adds distributed sensing and local processing through DIRTNet. In this room, we
must distinguish inference over recorded field measurements, synthetic test cases, and prerecorded
outputs. Each proves something different. A successful network simulation does not by itself establish
radio range or field endurance.
“The important evaluation is comparative. We should show the simple baseline, the learned component,
and the integrated result on the same held-out case. We should also show a missing source or
contradictory observation and explain what changed. If the integrated system adds no benefit, or
exceeds its compute budget, that is part of the result.
“Our next step with the Army is a bounded evaluation using an agreed unclassified scenario, a clear
rubric, and independent replay. That gives us a practical way to establish which parts improve analyst
work and which need further development.”
Source basis: Adapted from S19, S21–S26. Wording intentionally distinguishes architecture, proposed capabilities and
measured evidence.

MYCOSOFT  /  ITDX26 PREPARATION
7 SEPTEMBER 2026
Preparation supplement • Targets are not measured results
4
ITDX26 / PREPARATION & DOCUMENT REVIEW
One architecture, with clear maturity
boundaries
Component
Role to explain
Evidence boundary
NLM
Estimate state from calibrated signals and
temporal context.
The change-history document describes a
working 16-dimensional encoder and anomaly
path. It calls the full SSM/Mamba Form Space
engine a proposed refactor.
Form Space
Typed local charts, states, targets,
trajectories, uncertainty and scientific
hypotheses.
Broader than a clustering label. New target,
recovery and cross-substrate claims require
their own validation.
FUSARIUM / MYCA
Typed relationships; option generation,
critique and orchestration.
Show the actual graph model, model calls,
evidence use and bounded revision loop in
this run.
AVANI / MINDEX
External constraint checks; versioned
evidence and lineage.
A policy-status field or stored hash alone does
not establish enforcement, a signature, or
truth.
CREP / DIRTNet
Map projection; edge processing and
evidence synchronization.
A deterministic renderer can display uncertain
model outputs. A laptop network test
establishes software behavior only.
A defensible mathematical explanation
Use a versioned encoder and a fixed partition: x ~ y if Qᵥ(Λᵥ(x)) = Qᵥ(Λᵥ(y)), within a declared chart
and context. Equality of partition membership gives an equivalence relation. Its physical usefulness still
requires validation. If you instead use distance ≤ ε, call the groups similarity neighborhoods: pairwise
proximity is generally not transitive. Points at 0, 0.75ε and 1.5ε illustrate the problem. [S09, S15, S19]
Describe candidate COAs as trajectories in an admissible set under fixed constraints. “Submanifold”
needs regularity assumptions that the packet does not establish. Keep an analyst-specified goal
separate from a target inferred from natural dynamics.
What the two SQL files establish
The staged migrations define 18 core tables and 17 advanced tables. Core records include model
versions, charts, states, evidence, goal contracts, trajectories, interventions, recovery trials and an
outbox. Advanced records include invariants, equivalence hypotheses, cross-substrate tests, and
research trials. These are concrete schema artifacts, not deployment evidence. [S28–S29]
Enums permit lifecycle values but do not enforce the whole approval workflow. Intervention approval
fields can be null while a status says “executing”; cross-table space/chart consistency needs service or
database checks. PSILO sessions do have an explicit actions_enabled = false check, but that does not
establish external actuator isolation. Neither migration was executed in this review.
Source basis: S01–S02, S07, S17, S21–S25, S28–S29; repository corroboration R1–R2. Current live endpoints, weights and
deployed database state were not tested.

MYCOSOFT  /  ITDX26 PREPARATION
7 SEPTEMBER 2026
Preparation supplement • Targets are not measured results
5
ITDX26 / PREPARATION & DOCUMENT REVIEW
Task 12 / Pattern analysis
Your line: “This is the observation window, this is the baseline, this is the change we detected, and
these are the sources and uncertainties supporting it.”
Input: a frozen, approved sensor sequence or public event sequence with observation time, ingestion
time, source identity, calibration/quality, missingness and a declared cutoff. Treat field evidence and
public-event benchmarks as separate evaluation lanes. Scoring truth and injection markers must stay
outside the model inputs. [S01, S10, S19]
Step
What to do and show
1. Establish the
baseline
For sensor streams, show a robust median/MAD or z-score detector with persistence. For event
counts, use a seasonal/count-rate baseline. Choose the comparator appropriate to the actual
data.
2. Run the
declared model
Display checkpoint, model size, context window and input cutoff. Run the temporal model on
exactly the same held-out input. Explain persistent temporal state in plain language.
3. Inspect one
result
Open the ranked pattern worksheet: time interval, location if known, pattern description,
confidence, evidence, alternative explanation and disposition.
4. Test
corroboration
Add an independent source or remove a modality. Show whether the estimate and uncertainty
change. Duplicate observations from a common origin are not independent corroboration.
5. Show a failure
case
Inject sensor drift or a duplicate-report surge. The system should expose the quality problem or
degrade; it should not simply promote the change to a confirmed event.
Metrics to have ready
At a frozen threshold and review budget: precision, recall, F1 or average precision; detection time
together with missed-event rate; Brier score and calibration error; peak memory and end-to-end latency.
For class discovery, report stability across seeds with a permutation-invariant metric and the comparison
population. Provide measured values with denominators and intervals; a target value is not a result.
To justify the SSM architecture, compare with a suitable transformer or temporal baseline using the
same data split, prediction task and context budget. Report any truncation, parameter or compute
mismatch. “Linear scaling” by itself does not establish better accuracy or lower measured laptop
latency.
Fallback and evaluator handoff
If the learned checkpoint is unavailable or misses its budget, show the qualified baseline and label the
active mode. If neither is runnable, open a clearly labeled recorded result or static worksheet. Preserve
the input digest, threshold, predictions, timing log and evidence references in the handoff bundle.

A shorter spoken Form Space narrative
Suggested approximately four-minute version. Rehearse it once with a timer; spoken pace varies. The supplied five-minute
narrative has 1,313 words, about nine to ten minutes at 130–150 words per minute. Preserve its philosophical material for a
longer research discussion. [S26]
“The problem we are addressing is that an analyst receives many observations, but observations are not
yet a trustworthy picture of what is happening. Sensors can disagree, reports can repeat one another,
and a confident-looking answer can hide missing evidence.
“The Nature Learning Model is our approach to estimating state from grounded measurements. The
architecture brings together calibrated signal channels, temporal memory, and relationships between
observations. Every useful estimate should carry its time, source, model version, uncertainty, and
supporting evidence.
“Form Space changes what we want that estimate to represent. An embedding tells us where an
observation sits in a learned representation. A Form State is intended to say more: what organized state
the system appears to occupy, which local model applies, what target or stable region is relevant, and
what transitions are supported by evidence. It also records boundaries, missing information, and
whether a proposed transition is admissible.
“That is a research program with testable parts. If we claim that two states are equivalent for a task, we
must define the rule and show that the grouping remains useful on held-out observations. If we claim
recovery toward a target, we need a controlled comparison against passive dynamics, repeated
observations, and a stopping test. A signal anomaly alone does not establish a goal or prove a universal
theory of form.
“For ITDX, we make the idea concrete through four analyst products. Task 12 identifies a change or
recurring pattern. Task 13 tests and explains relationships, keeping observed connections separate from
inferred ones. Task 8 uses the resulting evidence to compare distinct options under explicit constraints.
Task 14 renders the state and evidence on a map that an analyst can inspect and export.
“MYCA coordinates the proposal and critique process. AVANI evaluates the declared constraints outside
the learned model. A passing gate means an option satisfied those checks; it does not grant command
authority. MINDEX preserves the versions and evidence lineage so an evaluator can inspect what
produced an answer.
“Our field architecture adds distributed sensing and local processing through DIRTNet. In this room, we
must distinguish inference over recorded field measurements, synthetic test cases, and prerecorded
outputs. Each proves something different. A successful network simulation does not by itself establish
radio range or field endurance.
“The important evaluation is comparative. We should show the simple baseline, the learned component,
and the integrated result on the same held-out case. We should also show a missing source or
contradictory observation and explain what changed. If the integrated system adds no benefit, or
exceeds its compute budget, that is part of the result.
“Our next step with the Army is a bounded evaluation using an agreed unclassified scenario, a clear
rubric, and independent replay. That gives us a practical way to establish which parts improve analyst
work and which need further development.”
Source basis: Adapted from S19, S21–S26. Wording intentionally distinguishes architecture, proposed capabilities and
measured evidence.

A defensible mathematical explanation
Use a versioned encoder and a fixed partition: x ~ y if Qᵥ(Λᵥ(x)) = Qᵥ(Λᵥ(y)), within a declared chart
and context. Equality of partition membership gives an equivalence relation. Its physical usefulness still
requires validation. If you instead use distance ≤ ε, call the groups similarity neighborhoods: pairwise
proximity is generally not transitive. Points at 0, 0.75ε and 1.5ε illustrate the problem. [S09, S15, S19]
Describe candidate COAs as trajectories in an admissible set under fixed constraints. “Submanifold”
needs regularity assumptions that the packet does not establish. Keep an analyst-specified goal
separate from a target inferred from natural dynamics.
What the two SQL files establish
The staged migrations define 18 core tables and 17 advanced tables. Core records include model
versions, charts, states, evidence, goal contracts, trajectories, interventions, recovery trials and an
outbox. Advanced records include invariants, equivalence hypotheses, cross-substrate tests, and
research trials. These are concrete schema artifacts, not deployment evidence. [S28–S29]
Enums permit lifecycle values but do not enforce the whole approval workflow. Intervention approval
fields can be null while a status says “executing”; cross-table space/chart consistency needs service or
database checks. PSILO sessions do have an explicit actions_enabled = false check, but that does not
establish external actuator isolation. Neither migration was executed in this review.

Task 12 / Pattern analysis
Your line: “This is the observation window, this is the baseline, this is the change we detected, and
these are the sources and uncertainties supporting it.”
Input: a frozen, approved sensor sequence or public event sequence with observation time, ingestion
time, source identity, calibration/quality, missingness and a declared cutoff. Treat field evidence and
public-event benchmarks as separate evaluation lanes. Scoring truth and injection markers must stay
outside the model inputs. [S01, S10, S19]
Step
What to do and show
1. Establish the
baseline
For sensor streams, show a robust median/MAD or z-score detector with persistence. For event
counts, use a seasonal/count-rate baseline. Choose the comparator appropriate to the actual
data.
2. Run the
declared model
Display checkpoint, model size, context window and input cutoff. Run the temporal model on

3. Inspect one
result

corroboration

case

At a frozen threshold and review budget: precision, recall, F1 or average precision; detection time
together with missed-event rate; Brier score and calibration error; peak memory and end-to-end latency.

population. Provide measured values with denominators and intervals; a target value is not a result.

same data split, prediction task and context budget. Report any truncation, parameter or compute
mismatch. “Linear scaling” by itself does not establish better accuracy or lower measured laptop
latency.

evidence types
